sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Shree Prakash Giri Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Ram Prakash Upadhyay Hon'ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.
Hon'ble Gajendra Kumar,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned A.G.A-I for the State respondents.

2. The relief sought in this petition is for quashing of the first information report dated 21.11.2022 as Case Crime No.0101 of 2022, Under Sections 498A, 323, 504 I.P.C., Police Station Mahila Thana,
District Agra.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On the matter being taken up today, learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that in the present matter chargesheet has been submitted against the petitioners and as such the reliefs claimed in the writ petition no more survives.
4. We have occasion to peruse the FIR as well as the relevant papers and find that cognizable offence is made out against the petitioners and as such no case is made out for quashing the FIR.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner further states that leave may be accorded to the petitioner to press the relief before the appropriate Court.
6. We accordingly dispose of the writ petition with the aforesaid leave.
